title: Smoker Fuel Refill Timing Alert
dataSources: Sourdough monitor (`sourdough:reading`), BBQ/sous-vide probes (`bbq:probe`), fridge/freezer/oven temperature (`kitchen:appliance`), espresso shots (`espresso:shot`), pantry inventory (`pantry:item`), kombucha brew (`kombucha:reading`).
app: ESP32/ESPHome kitchen sensors (sourdough rise, BBQ/sous-vide probes, fridge/freezer temperature), espresso-shot logs, and pantry inventory via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=bbq:probe
| stats latest(pit_temp_c) as pit_temp, latest(fuel_pct) as fuel_pct by cook_id
| where fuel_pct<20 AND pit_temp<110
| sort fuel_pct
description: Pairs falling pit temperature with low fuel level to tell you when a long smoke is about to need intervention before the stall becomes a failure.
value: Good barbecue is mostly patience plus timely intervention; this alert helps you add fuel before dinner timing starts slipping.
implementation: Forward smoker probe and hopper or fuel-sensor data; alert when low remaining fuel coincides with a cooling pit.
visualization: Cook table of current pit temperature and remaining fuel percentage.
grandmaExplanation: It maps when the smoker looks like it is running low on fuel and the temperature is starting to sag.
